**Finding submitted: deviation (medium severity), Section 13 (p0047).**

Summary of the review:

- The only non-solicitation provision in the agreement is § 13 (found in the § 7 block despite the numbering). Sections 1 and 6 (the planner's candidates) contain no no-hire or solicitation restriction.
- The clause largely tracks our fallback: it is **mutual**, scoped to **personnel with direct involvement in the Services**, limited to **one year post-termination** (well inside the 24-month walk-away), and is a **solicit-for-hire restriction rather than a no-hire**.
- The gap is the absence of the **general-advertising / unsolicited-approach carve-out**, which the rule summary treats as a condition of acceptance and which the fallback lists as a material term. As drafted, an ordinary job posting or hiring someone who approaches us on their own would need RadialSpark's consent.
- Redline (validated, `ok:true`): a single appended carve-out sentence to p0047 — the minimal edit to reach the fallback. I did not push the preferred position (strike the non-solicit entirely) because the clause is mutual and already narrowly scoped, so deletion would be disproportionate. The measurement of the term from termination rather than from the end of the individual's involvement is noted in the rationale as a minor variance, not flagged.
